models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Pre-trip look only: light NW airs and near-flat sea over the Aeolians now, but departure is 13 days out and well beyond any model.
briefing.synopsis: The current pattern is a slack, weakly gradient regime over the southern Tyrrhenian - winds mostly from the NW through W at 2-9 kt across all six island points, with a brief N/NE component at Panarea in the rehearsal scoring. ECMWF IFS 0.25° and AIFS (both 20 Sep 06Z) and ICON-2i (20 Sep 00Z) agree on the broad picture through 26 Sep, with a modest freshening on 22 Sep - Portorosa 8.7 kt WNW and Lipari 8.3 kt W at midday. Sea state stays small throughout: MFWAM (20 Sep 00Z) and ECMWF WAM (06Z) hold total wave 0.3-1.2 ft and swell 0.1-1.1 ft everywhere. The published forecast horizon ends 26 Sep 23:00, so nothing here extends to the 4-8 Oct trip dates.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight's rehearsal berth is Portorosa Marina, scored fully sheltered as an enclosed basin with all-round protection - the choice does not matter here as it is the only option. Portorosa shows 1.5 kt from the N at 18:00 and 3.3 kt SW by midnight (IFS/AIFS 06Z consensus), with wave 0.5 ft. Nothing in the payload would move a fleet off that berth.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: For 21 Sep the rehearsal has Portorosa to Lipari as a 'go' on a 06:00 departure, 5.4 kt close reach, no stated deterioration time. Note the models split at Portorosa midday on the 21st: 1.9 to 10.3 kt, a spread wide enough that the 5.3 kt mean should not be planned against. Sea stays 0.3 ft wave, 0.2 ft swell. Remember these dates are the dry run, not your departure - your first real leg is 4 Oct.

passage_notes.note: Go, 06:00, 5.4 kt close reach. Model spread 1.9-10.3 kt at Portorosa midday.
Go, 06:00, 8.8 kt beam reach. Waves building to about 1.0 ft off Lipari by midday.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Stromboli, optional (rehearsal 23 Sep; real 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 06:00, 10.9 kt head to wind - a motoring leg in this pattern.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (rehearsal 24 Sep; real 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 06:00, 2.9 kt broad reach. Gust to 13 kt on a 3 kt mean is an interval-maximum artefact, not a caution.
Go, 06:00, 12.1 kt on the nose; scoring flags deterioration after 10:00, so an early start pays.
Go, 06:00, 8.1 kt head to wind, deteriorating after 11:00. Gust to 23 kt is a single-model interval maximum.

cautions: The rehearsal verdicts are the real legs scored against late-September weather. They are a check on the method, not a forecast for 4-8 Oct - do not carry any of these numbers into trip planning.

Where 'models_range_kt' appears the models genuinely disagree by more than 6 kt (Portorosa 21 Sep midday 1.9-10.3 kt; Salina 20 Sep 06:00 2.1-10.9 kt and 22 Sep midday 2.7-11.6 kt). Treat the mean as unreliable at those hours.
IFS and ICON-2i gusts are interval maxima, so gust factors look inflated in light air - several show 13-23 kt against 3-8 kt means.
Panarea berth choice does matter on the 22 Sep rehearsal night: ENE 13 kt blows straight into San Pietro, and Drautto scores better. Worth carrying into the real trip as a habit, not as a forecast.
briefing.confidence_note: Short-range stability is good - mean wind shift between runs is only 0.6-1.2 kt out to 120 h across 13 snapshots - but the forecast horizon ends 26 Sep and the trip starts 4 Oct, so there is no model guidance at all for the actual dates.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
